schema: CREATE TABLE analysis_reports (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, report TEXT NOT NULL, audit TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE dataset_profiles (
                dataset_id TEXT NOT NULL, dataset_version TEXT NOT NULL, profile TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, dataset_version),
                FOREIGN KEY (dataset_id) REFERENCES datasets(id)
            )
CREATE TABLE datasets (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, file_info TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE execution_results (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, execution_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES executions(id),
                row_count INTEGER NOT NULL, columns_json TEXT NOT NULL, rows_json TEXT NOT NULL
            )

CREATE TABLE executions (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, request TEXT NOT NULL,
                session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id), status TEXT NOT NULL,
                started_at TEXT NOT NULL, approval TEXT NOT NULL, progress TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT
            )

CREATE TABLE plan_approvals (
                approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id),
                request_id TEXT NOT NULL, request TEXT NOT NULL, record TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(session_id, request_id))

CREATE TABLE plan_constraint_audits (
                approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES plan_approvals(approval_id),
                session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id), record TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE plan_versions (
                session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id), plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                plan_version INTEGER NOT NULL, record TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(session_id, plan_version))
CREATE TABLE report_generations (execution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, record TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE session_access (
                session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES sessions(id), token_hash TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TRIGGER plan_approvals_no_delete
                        BEFORE DELETE ON plan_approvals BEGIN
                        SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable HITL audit record'); END

CREATE TRIGGER plan_approvals_no_update
                        BEFORE UPDATE ON plan_approvals BEGIN
                        SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable HITL audit record'); END

CREATE TRIGGER plan_constraint_audits_no_delete
                        BEFORE DELETE ON plan_constraint_audits BEGIN
                        SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable HITL audit record'); END

CREATE TRIGGER plan_constraint_audits_no_update
                        BEFORE UPDATE ON plan_constraint_audits BEGIN
                        SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable HITL audit record'); END

CREATE TRIGGER plan_versions_no_delete
                        BEFORE DELETE ON plan_versions BEGIN
                        SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable HITL audit record'); END

CREATE TRIGGER plan_versions_no_update
                        BEFORE UPDATE ON plan_versions BEGIN
                        SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable HITL audit record'); END
CREATE INDEX events_span ON trace_events(span_id, sequence)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workflow_session_unique
            ON trace_runs(json_extract(record,'$.session_id'))
            WHERE json_extract(record,'$.kind')='workflow'

CREATE TABLE trace_events (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES trace_runs(id),
                    span_id TEXT REFERENCES trace_spans(id), sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, record TEXT NOT NULL,
                    UNIQUE(run_id, sequence))
CREATE TABLE trace_migrations (version TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

CREATE TABLE "trace_runs" (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, execution_id TEXT, attempt INTEGER NOT NULL,
                queued_at TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, record TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(execution_id, attempt))

CREATE TABLE trace_snapshots (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES trace_runs(id),
                    span_id TEXT REFERENCES trace_spans(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL, record TEXT NOT NULL,
                    UNIQUE(run_id,kind))

CREATE TABLE trace_spans (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES trace_runs(id), record TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE llm_calls (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
 run_id TEXT, span_id TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL, record TEXT NOT NULL,
 request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES llm_request_snapshots(id), UNIQUE(operation_id,sequence))

CREATE TABLE llm_request_payloads (
 snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES llm_request_snapshots(id), payload TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE llm_request_snapshots (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, template_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES prompt_templates(id), record TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE prompt_templates (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, node_id TEXT NOT NULL, version TEXT NOT NULL,
 content_hash TEXT NOT NULL, record TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(node_id,version))
CREATE TABLE registry_migrations (version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TRIGGER calls_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON llm_calls BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Preserve calls'); END
CREATE TRIGGER calls_terminal BEFORE UPDATE ON llm_calls WHEN OLD.status != 'running' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Terminal call'); END
CREATE TRIGGER payload_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON llm_request_payloads BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Immutable payload'); END
CREATE TRIGGER requests_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON llm_request_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Immutable request'); END
CREATE TRIGGER requests_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON llm_request_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Immutable request'); END
CREATE TRIGGER templates_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON prompt_templates BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Immutable template'); END
CREATE TRIGGER templates_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON prompt_templates BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Immutable template'); END
